summary: Iteration 12 (Final Hardening) — CROSS-ROLE QA + DEMO DATA ISOLATION + PRODUCTION CORS all VERIFIED PASS. Full /app/backend/tests/ regression under the locked pytest.ini (-n 2 --dist loadscope): 328 passed, 2 skipped, 0 failed in 367s. This covers all 29 cross-role tests in test_cross_role_qa.py (workflow propagation, approval gates, submission truth, permission matrix, privacy/masking + contact-access-log, demo accounts untouched), all 50 client_portal_isolation tests, all 13 clean_client_journey tests, all 9 test_zz_demo_portal_state tests, all 63 hardening/adversarial tests, plus every earlier Phase 1 / 1B / 1B_UX / Phase 2 / iteration6-11 suite. DEMO ISOLATION PROVEN by direct DB snapshot: BEFORE the run — Client A {cases:1, notifs:2, docs:2, tasks:2, pay:0} / Client B {cases:1, 0, 0, 0, 0}; AFTER the full 328-test run — identical, zero growth on every tracked collection. PRODUCTION CORS verified at the app boundary (http://localhost:8001 to bypass the Cloudflare preview edge which rewrites CORS): OPTIONS with Origin=https://taxsimba.co.uk → 200 + access-control-allow-origin: https://taxsimba.co.uk (echoed); www.taxsimba.co.uk → echoed; preview origin → echoed (still allowed via CORS_DEV_ORIGINS); attacker.example.com → 400 with NO allow-origin header. backend/.env cleanly separates CORS_ORIGINS (production only) from CORS_DEV_ORIGINS (preview only) with no wildcard, and server._allowed_origins() RuntimeErrors on '*' or empty in either. FRONTEND E2E: all 4 roles log in and land on the correct route (client→/dashboard, accountant.a/b→/work, admin→/admin, superadmin→/admin); every client route (/dashboard /actions /tasks /documents /my-return /services /journey /messages /help /settings /profile) renders without error; Tax Journey shows 'Ready to Submit' and 2025/26 with no 'Submitted to HMRC' label and no underscore constant leaking; logout works for every role. MOBILE at 390px: Documents renders as readable stacked cards (not four cramped columns), Messages/Dashboard/Help/Settings have no horizontal overflow. Settings page correctly shows the PENDING verification-mailbox pattern for email changes (does not swap the login email immediately) — this is the genuine 'no fake email delivery' path the user asked for.

minor.issue: Still no pagination — hard caps at 500 / 300. Not a regression from iteration 12, carried forward from iteration_11.

CSRF is defended via double-submit token + Sec-Fetch-Site/Referer allowlist for browser callers (verified in hardening suite) — non-issue for CLI, retained as an item to keep an eye on when a real production ingress replaces the Cloudflare preview edge.

action_items: REQUIRES EXTERNAL WORK BEFORE GO-LIVE — no HMRC API is integrated; a real submission is only recorded manually by an authorised admin. This is deliberate (no fake integrations) and must be replaced by a real HMRC MTD/SA API integration before the platform can genuinely file returns for clients.

REQUIRES EXTERNAL WORK BEFORE GO-LIVE — no email provider is integrated. Email-change verification, notifications and password-reset flows currently create PENDING records for staff review; wire up a real transactional email provider (Postmark/SES/SendGrid) before customer traffic.
REQUIRES EXTERNAL WORK BEFORE GO-LIVE — Stripe is TEST/SANDBOX only (STRIPE_MODE=test, sk_test_ keys). Switch to live keys and verify webhook signing against the production endpoint.

REQUIRES EXTERNAL WORK BEFORE GO-LIVE — the Cloudflare preview edge rewrites CORS OPTIONS to '*' regardless of the app. Re-validate the CORS allowlist end-to-end against the real production hostname/ingress once taxsimba.co.uk DNS/ingress is provisioned.
Non-blocking: add pagination + a role filter to /api/users and /api/recommendations to remove the 500/300 hard caps.
Non-blocking: migrate server.py off deprecated @app.on_event('startup') to FastAPI lifespan handlers.
critical_code_review_comments: The QA-client harness (tests/qa_clients.py + tests/conftest.py) is a well-designed guard-rail: session-scoped autouse fixture provisions the disposable accounts once, reset_qa_clients prunes older cases and read notifications each session, and demo_account_counts()/assert_demo_accounts_untouched() give an objective before/after diff. Zero pollution proven empirically.

server._allowed_origins() correctly RuntimeErrors on '*' or empty in either CORS_ORIGINS or CORS_DEV_ORIGINS (covered by test_startup_guard_rejects_wildcard_and_empty). Separation of prod vs preview allowlists is clean.

Cross-role test_cross_role_qa.py deliberately keeps TestCrossRoleWorkflow as one class so --dist loadscope keeps the sequential steps on a single xdist worker. That is the right fix for the fixture-rebuild issue and is documented in the test file.

The ownership gate _owned_case_ids() is the single source of truth for client-scope reads and is exercised by 50 isolation tests; no way found to bypass it via modified case/doc/message ids in either direction.
server.py is still large but modular by router — no >700-line function or component was flagged; deprecated on_event usage aside, code quality is consistent with iteration 11.

success_rate.frontend: 100% — all 4 role logins, all 10 client routes, mobile 5 routes, journey/label/tax-year checks green

test_credentials: Used credentials from /app/memory/test_credentials.md exactly. Mutating tests use the disposable QA_CLIENT_A/QA_CLIENT_B accounts as required.
seed_data_creation: None. QA disposable clients (qa.client.a@qa-taxsimba.example.com, qa.client.b@qa-taxsimba.example.com) are provisioned idempotently by tests/qa_clients.py::ensure_qa_clients() and pruned by reset_qa_clients() per session. Persistent demo accounts (clienta@/clientb@example.com) were NOT touched — verified by DB snapshot diff = 0 across the entire 328-test run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Final hardening iteration is fully verified. If you need to re-run: (1) do NOT modify pytest.ini (fixed at -n 2 --dist loadscope). (2) Snapshot demo counts before + after using qa_clients.demo_account_counts() to prove no pollution. (3) Test CORS at http://localhost:8001, NEVER via the preview hostname (the Cloudflare edge rewrites CORS). (4) test_zz_demo_portal_state.py runs LAST and re-normalises the demo portal — respect the ordering. (5) The three items still requiring external integration/configuration are HMRC API, email provider and live Stripe — see action_items. Nothing else is fake or placeholder.
